governing_core_finding: Core K7 states recursion/induction are not primitive leaves and requires represented well-founded or inductive carrier authority. Core K8 separately excludes arithmetic/cardinality. Generic arithmetic can be schema-defined once inductive data authority exists.

refinement.reason: DNIA itself can be derived as a schema module from Core plus a generic well-founded constructor/structural-induction authority. Introducing natural arithmetic as the primitive would be less neutral and larger than necessary.

DNWF_required_semantics: finite constructor signature with ordered fields
generated carrier contains all and only finite well-founded constructor trees admitted by the signature
constructor disjointness and injectivity/extensional field equality
structural induction over the generated carrier
structural recursion/fold existence and uniqueness into an arbitrary target algebra

after_DNWF.note: Natural zero/successor data, addition, multiplication, order, finite indices/cardinality, integers/rationals, tuples and folds become Core+DNWF schemas.

minimality_claim: DNWF is the only candidate new semantic primitive extension presently forced by the frozen v0.1 capability dependency model. This is revision-scoped and must be falsified by qualification; it is not yet authority.
guards: Do not promote the historical primitive-natural-arithmetic candidate.
Do not let W or L consume DNWF or DNIA before independent qualification.
If DNWF itself can be reduced under current Core without hidden induction authority, this audit is falsified and no new semantic primitive should be added.
